I originally purchased this product through the seller’s direct link, but unfortunately the link did not work and I was never able to access or open the files. After multiple attempts, I ultimately had to repurchase the same product through Etsy in order to receive the files.

I contacted the seller via email to request a refund for the original purchase and provided the proof she requested, showing that the files could not be accessed. Despite this, I did not receive a refund.
The product itself was accessible once purchased through Etsy, but I would strongly recommend buying only through Etsy. My experience using the direct link was problematic and unresolved.
